nodes.text:
Request -Precautionary step must need to be taken to avoid HMPV in india.
1.Conduct thermal screening and health checks at airports. 
2.Train staff in infection control and HMPV management.
3.Monitor respiratory infections and detect HMPV cases early.
@PMOIndia @CMOMaharashtra
